assertions.assertion: Nine versioned nodes execute in one fixed order with no dynamic or conversational graph.
Authorization, risk, data and budget gates precede retrieval, Tool and model ports.
C08 remains the Run Ledger authority, C12 owns its orchestration checkpoint, and C11, C14, C16 and HumanDecision remain external authority-bearing ports.
DRAFT binds the frozen input, non-empty C11 evidence set and C16 Tool result/evidence into one context hash.
Every Tool node passes the trusted identity/delegation envelope and accepts only C16 operation-specific reauthorization and confirmation evidence.

Every node records exact input/output hashes, owner, node version, closed dependency binding metadata and its binding hash; review records contain distinct server-bound draft and review model identities.
TaskState and every authority-bearing node input/result have closed versioned JSON Schema contracts and API error shapes.
Catalog policy, knowledge, Skill, model-task, review-model and Tool bindings match frozen C06, C11, C13, C14 and C16 artifacts, while C08 is explicitly hash-bound as a contract-only dependency.
All runnable P1 tasks wait for a bound non-production HumanDecision before completion.

DRAFT and INDEPENDENT_REVIEW model Token and cost usage accumulate into one task budget, review usage is checkpoint-bound, and any cumulative model or Tool count overage fails before checkpoint advancement.

Stable node effect keys, atomic expected versions and receipts bound to Tenant, Human/Workload principals, Task, operation, idempotency key, request hash, result version and result state hash survive ACK loss, reject forged replay flags and stale concurrency, collapse concurrent exact START/ADVANCE/RESUME commands, bind every State Port result to the operation postcondition and let an idempotent downstream collapse pre-checkpoint retries.
Checkpoint state contains references, hashes, versions and counts but no prompt, body, bytes, credentials or session token.
